articles.summary: SID-1 is the first model trained end-to-end with RL solely for agentic retrieval. It reaches 0.84 recall on a diverse benchmark, compared to 0.78 for GPT-5.1 and 0.45 for traditional reranking pipelines. This report covers our infrastructure, reward design, synthetic data, and issues with common GRPO formulations.
articles.title: SID-1 Technical Report: Test-Time Compute for Retrieval
